question: What qualification must a previously accomplished recipient meet before this teaching is to be given to him?
premises: The teaching is not to be given indiscriminately to all recipients.
A previously accomplished person is a candidate for receiving it.
That candidate must have been tested for a full year.
inference: The teaching is to be given only to one previously accomplished who has been tested for one year.
uncertainties: Nature of the year-long test remains unspecified
plain_english: It is to be given to one who was previously accomplished and has been tested for one year.
